#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
IEEE S&P Poster: Bot Mitigation at Scale
Operational Precision - Museum-quality academic poster
"""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, Rectangle, Circle, FancyArrowPatch, PathPatch
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import matplotlib.font_manager as fm
import matplotlib.path as mpath
import numpy as np
from datetime import datetime
import os

# Register custom fonts
font_dir = '/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts'
for font_file in os.listdir(font_dir):
    if font_file.endswith('.ttf'):
        fm.fontManager.addfont(os.path.join(font_dir, font_file))

# A1 portrait: 23.4 x 33.1 inches at 150 DPI
FIG_WIDTH = 23.4
FIG_HEIGHT = 33.1
DPI = 150

# Color palette - Refined Operational Precision
BG_PRIMARY = '#080b14'
BG_SECONDARY = '#0f1624'
BG_CARD = '#141c2e'
BG_CARD_ALT = '#1a2438'
ACCENT_PRIMARY = '#00d4ff'
ACCENT_SECONDARY = '#0891b2'
ACCENT_HOT = '#22d3ee'
ACCENT_WARN = '#f59e0b'
TEXT_PRIMARY = '#f8fafc'
TEXT_SECONDARY = '#94a3b8'
TEXT_MUTED = '#475569'
GRID_COLOR = '#1e293b'
DIVIDER = '#1e3a5f'

# Fonts
FONT_HEADING = 'Big Shoulders'
FONT_BODY = 'Instrument Sans'
FONT_MONO = 'DM Mono'

def draw_subtle_grid(ax, x_range, y_range, spacing=0.4):
    """Draw barely perceptible grid for precision feel"""
    for x in np.arange(x_range[0], x_range[1], spacing):
        ax.plot([x, x], y_range, color=GRID_COLOR, linewidth=0.2, alpha=0.4)
    for y in np.arange(y_range[0], y_range[1], spacing):
        ax.plot(x_range, [y, y], color=GRID_COLOR, linewidth=0.2, alpha=0.4)

def draw_section_divider(ax, y, left_x=1.2, right_x=22.2):
    """Draw subtle section divider"""
    ax.plot([left_x, right_x], [y, y], color=DIVIDER, linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.6)

def draw_section_label(ax, x, y, text):
    """Draw minimal section label"""
    ax.text(x, y, text, fontsize=8, fontweight='bold', color=ACCENT_PRIMARY,
            fontfamily=FONT_HEADING, va='top', tracking='wide')

def draw_subsection_label(ax, x, y, text):
    """Draw subsection label"""
    ax.text(x, y, text, fontsize=7, fontweight='bold', color=TEXT_SECONDARY,
            fontfamily=FONT_BODY, va='top', style='italic')

def draw_large_metric(ax, x, y, value, label1, label2, highlight_color=ACCENT_HOT):
    """Draw dominant metric display"""
    # Value with glow effect
    text = ax.text(x, y, value, fontsize=80, fontweight='bold',
                   color=highlight_color, fontfamily=FONT_HEADING, va='center', ha='center')
    text.set_path_effects([
        pe.withStroke(linewidth=12, foreground=BG_PRIMARY),
        pe.Normal()
    ])

    # Primary label
    ax.text(x, y - 0.9, label1, fontsize=12, color=TEXT_PRIMARY,
            fontfamily=FONT_BODY, va='top', ha='center')

    # Secondary label
    ax.text(x, y - 1.2, label2, fontsize=10, color=TEXT_SECONDARY,
            fontfamily=FONT_BODY, va='top', ha='center')

def draw_metric_row(ax, x, y, value, label, width=2.2):
    """Draw compact metric in a row"""
    # Subtle container
    rect = Rectangle((x, y - 0.55), width, 0.55,
                      facecolor=BG_CARD, edgecolor=DIVIDER, linewidth=0.5)
    ax.add_patch(rect)

    # Value
    ax.text(x + width/2, y - 0.22, value, fontsize=18, fontweight='bold',
            color=TEXT_PRIMARY, fontfamily=FONT_HEADING, ha='center', va='center')

    # Label
    ax.text(x + width/2, y - 0.48, label, fontsize=5.5, color=TEXT_MUTED,
            fontfamily=FONT_BODY, ha='center', va='top')

def draw_pipeline(ax, start_x, start_y):
    """Draw the 5-stage verification pipeline with precision"""

    stages = [
        {'num': '1', 'title': 'Request\nInterception', 'time': '<50 ms',
         'detail': 'CDN edge node routes incoming HTTP request'},
        {'num': '2', 'title': 'Threat\nScoring', 'time': '~100 ms',
         'detail': 'IP reputation, TLS fingerprint, behavioral signals'},
        {'num': '3', 'title': 'Challenge\nIssuance', 'time': '~500 ms',
         'detail': 'JavaScript challenge or CAPTCHA served to client'},
        {'num': '4', 'title': 'Verification\nCheck', 'time': '~200 ms',
         'detail': 'Validate response, assign unique Ray ID for tracing'},
        {'num': '5', 'title': 'Access\nGrant', 'time': '<50 ms',
         'detail': 'Forward verified user to origin with session token'},
    ]

    stage_w = 2.3
    stage_h = 1.15
    gap = 0.35
    total_w = len(stages) * stage_w + (len(stages) - 1) * gap

    # Subtle background track
    track_y = start_y - stage_h/2
    rect = Rectangle((start_x - 0.1, track_y - 0.05), total_w + 0.2, stage_h + 0.1,
                      facecolor=BG_SECONDARY, edgecolor='none', zorder=0)
    ax.add_patch(rect)

    # Draw stages
    for i, stage in enumerate(stages):
        x = start_x + i * (stage_w + gap)

        # Stage container
        rect = FancyBboxPatch((x, start_y - stage_h), stage_w, stage_h,
                              boxstyle="round,pad=0.008,rounding_size=0.012",
                              facecolor=BG_CARD, edgecolor=ACCENT_SECONDARY,
                              linewidth=1, zorder=2)
        ax.add_patch(rect)

        # Stage number
        circle = Circle((x + 0.18, start_y - 0.18), 0.12,
                        facecolor=ACCENT_PRIMARY, edgecolor='none', zorder=3)
        ax.add_patch(circle)
        ax.text(x + 0.18, start_y - 0.18, stage['num'], fontsize=8,
                fontweight='bold', color=BG_PRIMARY, ha='center', va='center', zorder=4)

        # Title
        ax.text(x + stage_w/2, start_y - 0.38, stage['title'], fontsize=7.5,
                fontweight='bold', color=TEXT_PRIMARY, fontfamily=FONT_HEADING,
                ha='center', va='top', zorder=4)

        # Time badge
        rect = FancyBboxPatch((x + stage_w/2 - 0.35, start_y - stage_h + 0.08), 0.7, 0.18,
                              boxstyle="round,pad=0.003,rounding_size=0.03",
                              facecolor=BG_SECONDARY, edgecolor=ACCENT_PRIMARY,
                              linewidth=0.5, zorder=4)
        ax.add_patch(rect)
        ax.text(x + stage_w/2, start_y - stage_h + 0.17, stage['time'], fontsize=5.5,
                color=ACCENT_PRIMARY, fontfamily=FONT_MONO, ha='center', va='center', zorder=5)

        # Detail text
        ax.text(x + stage_w/2, start_y - 0.85, stage['detail'], fontsize=5,
                color=TEXT_MUTED, fontfamily=FONT_BODY, ha='center', va='top',
                wrap=True, zorder=4)

        # Connector arrow
        if i < len(stages) - 1:
            arrow_start = x + stage_w
            arrow_end = start_x + (i + 1) * (stage_w + gap)
            mid_x = (arrow_start + arrow_end) / 2

            # Arrow line
            ax.annotate('', xy=(arrow_end - 0.05, start_y - stage_h/2),
                        xytext=(arrow_start + 0.05, start_y - stage_h/2),
                        arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=ACCENT_SECONDARY,
                                       lw=1.5, shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0), zorder=3)

            # Small node at midpoint
            node = Circle((mid_x, start_y - stage_h/2), 0.04,
                          facecolor=ACCENT_PRIMARY, edgecolor='none', zorder=5)
            ax.add_patch(node)

    return total_w

def draw_comparison_table(ax, x, y):
    """Draw before/after comparison table"""
    headers = ['Metric', 'Before', 'After', 'Δ']
    col_widths = [2.8, 1.3, 1.3, 1.0]
    row_height = 0.28

    # Header
    cx = x
    for i, (h, w) in enumerate(zip(headers, col_widths)):
        rect = Rectangle((cx, y), w, row_height,
                          facecolor=BG_SECONDARY, edgecolor=DIVIDER, linewidth=0.5)
        ax.add_patch(rect)
        ax.text(cx + w/2, y + row_height/2, h, fontsize=6, fontweight='bold',
                color=ACCENT_PRIMARY if i > 0 else TEXT_SECONDARY,
                fontfamily=FONT_BODY, ha='center', va='center')
        cx += w

    # Data rows
    data = [
        ('Scraping attempts / day', '~1,200,000', '~180,000', '−85%'),
        ('Origin server CPU load', '78%', '42%', '−36%'),
        ('User complaints / month', '1,200', '340', '−72%'),
        ('Uptime during surges', '98.5%', '99.97%', '+1.47%'),
    ]

    for row_idx, row in enumerate(data):
        cx = x
        row_y = y - (row_idx + 1) * row_height
        facecolor = BG_CARD if row_idx % 2 == 0 else BG_CARD_ALT

        for col_idx, (cell, w) in enumerate(zip(row, col_widths)):
            rect = Rectangle((cx, row_y), w, row_height,
                              facecolor=facecolor, edgecolor=DIVIDER, linewidth=0.3)
            ax.add_patch(rect)

            color = TEXT_PRIMARY if col_idx == 0 else (
                ACCENT_HOT if col_idx == 3 else TEXT_SECONDARY)
            ax.text(cx + w/2, row_y + row_height/2, cell, fontsize=5.5,
                    color=color, fontfamily=FONT_BODY if col_idx > 0 else FONT_HEADING,
                    ha='center', va='center')
            cx += w

    return 4 * row_height  # Return total height

def draw_tradeoff_card(ax, x, y, title, description, width=5.2, height=0.85):
    """Draw a tradeoff consideration card"""
    # Accent bar on left
    rect = Rectangle((x, y - height), 0.05, height, facecolor=ACCENT_PRIMARY, edgecolor='none')
    ax.add_patch(rect)

    # Card background
    rect = Rectangle((x + 0.05, y - height), width - 0.05, height,
                      facecolor=BG_CARD, edgecolor=DIVIDER, linewidth=0.5)
    ax.add_patch(rect)

    # Title
    ax.text(x + 0.2, y - 0.18, title, fontsize=8, fontweight='bold',
            color=TEXT_PRIMARY, fontfamily=FONT_BODY, va='top')

    # Description
    ax.text(x + 0.2, y - 0.42, description, fontsize=6,
            color=TEXT_SECONDARY, fontfamily=FONT_BODY, va='top', wrap=True)

def draw_takeaway(ax, x, y, num, text):
    """Draw a numbered takeaway point"""
    # Number badge
    circle = Circle((x + 0.12, y - 0.12), 0.14, facecolor=ACCENT_SECONDARY, edgecolor='none')
    ax.add_patch(circle)
    ax.text(x + 0.12, y - 0.12, str(num), fontsize=7, fontweight='bold',
            color=TEXT_PRIMARY, ha='center', va='center')

    # Text
    ax.text(x + 0.38, y - 0.12, text, fontsize=7.5, color=TEXT_SECONDARY,
            fontfamily=FONT_BODY, va='center')

def create_poster():
    """Create the complete poster"""
    fig = plt.figure(figsize=(FIG_WIDTH, FIG_HEIGHT), facecolor=BG_PRIMARY)
    ax = fig.add_axes([0, 0, 1, 1])
    ax.set_xlim(0, FIG_WIDTH)
    ax.set_ylim(0, FIG_HEIGHT)
    ax.axis('off')

    # Subtle precision grid
    draw_subtle_grid(ax, [0, FIG_WIDTH], [0, FIG_HEIGHT], spacing=0.5)

    # ===== HEADER =====
    header_y = 32.0

    # Conference identifier
    ax.text(1.2, header_y, 'IEEE SYMPOSIUM ON SECURITY & PRIVACY 2026', fontsize=9,
            fontweight='bold', color=ACCENT_PRIMARY, fontfamily=FONT_HEADING, va='top')

    # Vertical accent line
    ax.plot([0.6, 0.6], [header_y - 0.6, 29.0], color=ACCENT_PRIMARY, linewidth=2.5)

    # Main title - two lines
    ax.text(1.2, header_y - 0.7, 'Bot Mitigation at Scale:', fontsize=32,
            fontweight='bold', color=TEXT_PRIMARY, fontfamily=FONT_HEADING, va='top')
    ax.text(1.2, header_y - 1.4, 'Protecting Scientific Publishing Platforms', fontsize=24,
            fontweight='bold', color=TEXT_SECONDARY, fontfamily=FONT_HEADING, va='top')

    # Subtitle
    ax.text(1.2, header_y - 1.95, 'CDN-based challenge verification systems safeguarding academic content', fontsize=10,
            color=TEXT_MUTED, fontfamily=FONT_BODY, va='top')

    # Source citation
    ax.text(1.2, 29.3, 'Source: 2024 Industry Bot Traffic Analysis  ·  Case: science.org (AAAS)', fontsize=6.5,
            color=TEXT_MUTED, fontfamily=FONT_MONO, va='top')

    # ===== SECTION 01: THREAT LANDSCAPE =====
    sec1_y = 28.6
    draw_section_divider(ax, sec1_y + 0.2)
    draw_section_label(ax, 1.2, sec1_y, '01  THE BOT THREAT LANDSCAPE')

    threat_y = sec1_y - 0.4

    # Primary stat - 47%
    ax.text(1.5, threat_y, '47%', fontsize=88, fontweight='bold',
            color=ACCENT_HOT, fontfamily=FONT_HEADING, va='top')
    ax.text(4.2, threat_y - 0.3, 'of all internet traffic', fontsize=14,
            color=TEXT_PRIMARY, fontfamily=FONT_BODY, va='top')
    ax.text(4.2, threat_y - 0.6, 'originates from bots (2024)', fontsize=11,
            color=TEXT_SECONDARY, fontfamily=FONT_BODY, va='top')

    # Secondary stat - 30%
    ax.text(1.5, threat_y - 1.6, '30%', fontsize=42, fontweight='bold',
            color=ACCENT_SECONDARY, fontfamily=FONT_HEADING, va='top')
    ax.text(2.8, threat_y - 1.5, 'of bot traffic classified as malicious', fontsize=11,
            color=TEXT_SECONDARY, fontfamily=FONT_BODY, va='center')

    # Bot composition bar
    bar_y = threat_y - 2.3
    bar_width = 6.0
    bar_height = 0.35

    ax.text(1.2, bar_y + 0.2, 'Bot Traffic Composition', fontsize=7.5,
            fontweight='bold', color=TEXT_PRIMARY, fontfamily=FONT_HEADING, va='bottom')

    # Background
    rect = Rectangle((1.2, bar_y - 0.15), bar_width, bar_height,
                      facecolor=BG_SECONDARY, edgecolor='none')
    ax.add_patch(rect)

    # Good bots (70%)
    rect = Rectangle((1.2, bar_y - 0.15), bar_width * 0.70, bar_height,
                      facecolor='#0f4a3d', edgecolor='none')
